docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Bühler’s Sanskrit text of the Pañcatantra with introduction and notes in the Bombay Sanskrit Series: the second part of the school edition of the five books (Bombay, 1891). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Panchatantra · Bühler, Georg, 1837-1896 · 1891, 102 scanned pages. Published 1891; Georg Bühler died 1898; the text is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the text of this book is in a script the machine reading of the scans cannot yet give.
